* If you're going to play with [[Tatooine]] sites, these are a must. [[Tatooine: Cantina{{!}}Cantina]] is a 2/2 site and Mos Eisley lets you move to and from there for free during your control phase. So, stack your characters on one of those two sites to better withstand a battle, then on your control phase move some of them over to the other, drain at both, and then move the ones you didn't move yet to re-consolidate your forces.
* [[Tatooine: Mos Eisley]] + [[Spaceport Speeders]] Once you're there movement is free, so you don't need the speeder anymore. Why not sell it for 2 or 3 destiny worth of force?
* Fun Combo: Everybody likes bar games. Toss down a Holoboard and play a little Dejarik while throwing back a little [[Blue Milk]] in the [[Tatooine: Cantina{{!}}Cantina]].
